test_name: Risk Assessment - RA-7 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Grants-Workflow-158
Primary NIST family: Risk Assessment (RA); evidence focus: RA-7.
Environment: Azure. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: a low residual-risk acceptance record is approved but its dashboard status has not yet synchronized. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
